column1: # Per-file count of PROSE literals OUTSIDE UI positions (design-marathi §3.3 b): a Latin word beside a
# space, or a capitalised word. I18nLiteralTest fails when a file's count differs. A rise means a new literal:
# key it, list it in unkeyed.tsv, or mark it `// text:value <why>`. A fall: run gradle :pano:i18nRatchet,
# which only ever LOWERS these counts. Never raise one by hand.
